title: Scalable Geospatial Machine Learning for Power-Line Asset Risk: Integrating Remote Sensing for Lightning and Vegetation Risk Modelling
abstract: arXiv:2608.18611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electric power networks are increasingly exposed to weather-sensitive failure mechanisms that require asset-level, spatially explicit risk modelling for effective intervention planning. This study contributes a modular, robust, and explainable probability-of-failure (PoF) modelling framework for utility asset management. The central contribution is an asset-level architecture that can be scaled to new environmental data sources and additional PoF types without reworking the underlying pipeline. This is particularly relevant for industry settings, where risk models must remain operationally maintainable while adapting to changing data availability, asset-management priorities, and climate-driven hazard conditions. We demonstrate the framework for vegetation-related and lightning-related failure modes using a harmonised geospatial machine-learning pipeline. translated_title: 可扩展的地理空间机器学习用于电力线路资产风险：整合遥感进行雷电与植被风险建模
translated_abstract: 电力网络日益面临对天气敏感的故障机制，这些机制需要资产级、空间明确的风险建模以进行有效的干预规划。本研究为公用事业资产管理贡献了一个模块化、稳健且可解释的故障概率（PoF）建模框架。核心贡献是一个资产级架构，该架构可扩展到新的环境数据源和额外的PoF类型，而无需重构底层管道。这在工业环境中尤为重要，因为风险模型必须在适应不断变化的数据可用性、资产管理优先事项和气候驱动的灾害条件的同时，保持操作上的可维护性。我们使用一个协调的地理空间机器学习管道，展示了该框架在植被相关和雷电相关故障模式中的应用。该实现整合了多源预测因子，包括地形（SRTM）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化、可扩展且可解释的资产级故障概率建模框架，整合多源地理空间数据，用于电力线路的雷电和植被风险预测，无需重构底层管道即可适应新数据源和故障类型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a modular, scalable, and explainable asset-level probability-of-failure modeling framework that integrates multi-source geospatial data for lightning and vegetation risk prediction in power-line networks, adaptable to new data sources and failure types without pipeline rework.
